about.text: The traditional fermented buffalo-milk gel of Sri Lanka, set by back-slopping in a clay pot. It is thicker, creamier and whiter than cow's-milk yoghurt and is eaten with kithul palm treacle.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Along highways in shallow earthen pots, for breakfast or dessert
At weddings, at alms-giving and at home, especially in the south
